summary: China A-shares in stagflation with PBoC easing in progress; extended tech/semis leadership and deep value pullbacks set up for mean reversion, while Hong Kong groans under global risk-off, peg outflows, and fear.
regime_read: Mainland China sits in Q3 stagflation: growth score -0.286, inflation 0.818, confidence low at 0.37. Liquidity overlay neutral but cumulative RRR/LPR cuts signal easing momentum not yet reflected in the regime. A-shares sector RS shows Semiconductors and Technology massively outperforming (60d +68%/+53%) but with technology at 77th percentile and semi below 200d trend – these look extended. Deeply oversold areas (Baijiu, Consumer Staples, Coal, Real Estate at sub-2 percentile with -25%+ 60d) offer higher-odds reversal setups, consistent with the mean-reversion thesis, though stagflation macro may delay rotation. Hong Kong's Reflation quadrant masks the real story: global risk score -0.69, peg weak-side with outflows, risk-off fear spike, and collapsing breadth. The island's sector leadership in Financials (99th percentile) may be peaking, while Internet/Tech underperforms despite A-share tech strength, underscoring HK's dependency on global risk and the dollar.
conflicts: High China inflation score (0.818) contradicts the inflation-beta basket's -23% 20d drop – markets are discounting stagflation where cost-push inflation doesn't lift equity cyclicals.
Smallcap/largecap ratio up 5.3% despite weak growth score – suggests speculative liquidity from easing, but fragile against the macro backdrop.
PBoC stance officially neutral while cuts are delivered; the 'easing in progress' hasn't yet flipped the corridor classifier, signaling the market may be ahead of the central bank's confirmation.
rotation_check: Reality tracks the working thesis. A-shares show classic mean-reversion setup: momentum extremes in tech/semis and deep discounts in defensive/value sectors. Hong Kong's divergence from mainland, driven by global risk-off and dollar strength, confirms the hypothesis that HK rides global factors more. The only tension is that radar-detected PMI→commodity divergences (Nonferrous metals, New-energy vehicle) are emerging but unproven; if activity data firms, the rotation could pivot toward these laggards, which would still align with mean-reversion but add a fundamental tailwind.
transmission: USD strength (trend up, restrictive real rates) → HKD weakness and capital outflows → tighter HK financial conditions → pressure on HK equities, especially property and high-beta.
PBoC easing (further RRR/LPR cuts) → lower onshore rates → potential CNY depreciation if not managed, which could benefit A-share exporters but strain HK via correlated outflows.
US real 10y at 2.19% acting as a discount rate headwind for gold and copper despite commodity-favored Goldilocks regime; China PMI improvement could counteract that for industrial metals.
HK property regime 'recovering' with CCL +17.5% YoY but property stocks lagging – if global risk subsides, this divergence may close.
watch_items: NBS PMI release (Jun 30) – improvement would validate radar divergences and strengthen the case for oversold cyclicals to mean-revert.
PBOC's next move on RRR/LPR – a cut that shifts the stance to explicit easing could unlock the 'easing-reflation' chain, boosting brokers/property.
USD/CNY fix & HKD peg distance – if USD/CNY breaks above 6.85 or HKD breaches 7.85, HK outflows could accelerate, worsening risk-off.
US macro data that could alter the Goldilocks/contracting liquidity narrative – a shift to restrictive or recessionary would be a major headwind.

zh.summary: 中国A股处于滞胀状态，央行宽松进行中；科技/半导体板块领涨且已显过度，深度价值回调为均值回归创造条件，而香港在全球避险、联系汇率制资金外流与恐慌情绪下承压。
zh.regime_read: 中国大陆处于第三季度滞胀：增长得分-0.286，通胀0.818，信心指数低至0.37。流动性整体中性，但累计降准/LPR降息信号显示宽松势头尚未体现在体制中。A股板块相对强度显示半导体和科技大幅跑赢（60日+68%/+53%），但科技处于第77百分位，半导体低于200日均线——这些看起来已过度。深度超卖领域（白酒、必需消费、煤炭、房地产处于第2百分位以下，60日跌幅超25%）提供更高概率的反转机会，符合均值回归论点，尽管滞胀宏观可能延迟轮动。香港的再通胀象限掩盖了真实情况：全球风险得分-0.69，联系汇率制弱势方出现资金外流，风险厌恶恐慌飙升，广度崩溃。该岛金融板块领导地位（第99百分位）可能见顶，而互联网/科技尽管A股科技强势却表现不佳，凸显香港对全球风险与美元的依赖。
zh.rotation_check: 现实符合工作假设。A股呈现经典均值回归形态：科技/半导体动量极端，防御型/价值板块深度折价。香港与内地走势分化，由全球避险和美元走强驱动，证实了香港更多受全球因素影响的假设。唯一的紧张点是雷达监测到的PMI→商品背离（有色金属、新能源汽车）正在显现但尚未得到证实；如果活动数据走强，轮动可能转向这些落后板块，这仍符合均值回归，但会增添基本面顺风。
conflicts: 中国高通胀得分（0.818）与通胀贝塔篮子20日下跌23%相矛盾——市场正在折价滞胀，其中成本推动型通胀并未提振股市周期股。
小盘/大盘比率上涨5.3%，尽管增长得分疲弱——暗示来自宽松的投机性流动性，但在宏观背景下脆弱。
央行立场官方中性但实际已降息；'宽松进行中'尚未翻转走廊分类器，表明市场可能领先于央行的确认。
transmission: 美元走强（趋势向上，实际利率限制性）→ 港元走弱和资本外流 → 香港金融条件收紧 → 港股承压，尤其是地产和高贝塔板块。
中国央行宽松（进一步降准/降LPR）→ 在岸利率下降 → 若管理不当可能导致人民币贬值，这有利于A股出口商，但通过相关外流令香港承压。
美国实际10年期利率为2.19%，对黄金和铜构成贴现率逆风，尽管是大宗商品有利的"金发姑娘"环境；中国PMI改善可能抵消这一影响，利好工业金属。
香港楼市'复苏'，中原城市领先指数（CCL）同比上涨17.5%，但地产股滞后——若全球风险消退，这一背离可能收敛。
watch_items: 国家统计局PMI数据发布（6月30日）——若改善将验证雷达背离，增强超卖周期股均值回归的理由。
中国央行下一步降准/降LPR——若降息使立场转向明确宽松，可能解锁'宽松-再通胀'链条，提振券商/地产。
USD/CNY 中间价与港元联系汇率距离——若USD/CNY突破6.85或港元触及7.85，香港资金外流可能加速，加剧避险情绪。
可能改变金发姑娘/流动性紧缩叙事的美国宏观数据——转向紧缩或衰退将构成重大阻力。
